run_diatomic_energy_curves: run diatomic potential energy curve computation for omol or omat tasks using a pretrained MLIP model
compute_diatomic_curve: compute the diatomic potential energy curve for a pair of atoms across 100 distances using a predictor model
generate_plot: generate a matplotlib plot of a diatomic potential energy curve and save it as a PNG file
combined_plot: generate a combined matplotlib plot of multiple diatomic potential energy curves and save it as a PNG file
get_model: load a pretrained MLIP model for prediction using either load_predict_unit or get_predict_unit depending on release status
